name: Product Companies
oa_pattern: 2–4 OA rounds: DSA mediums + MCQs; system design lite later

projects: Critical differentiator for frontend/product roles
hr_questions: Why this company?|Conflict with PM|Failure story|Ownership example
strategy: Your path: frontend/product engineer—portfolio > 500 CP problems.

communication: Authentic, curious, show what you shipped
projects: Primary hiring signal
hr_questions: Why startup?|Comfort with ambiguity|Side projects|48-hour task approach
strategy: Lead with HireLens + Anony Talk demos; contribute to open source.
